speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: And, indeed, one of the motivations for me to ask the question was because I went for such a visit with my family, and what I observed was, in contrast to many other countries, the discount turns out to be a very small fraction of the total ticket price.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: More generally, it makes me wonder whether there could be a greater effort by the Government for either, perhaps, a one-off ticket that could be available for every household who are in the Singaporean Core so that they can at least experience these world-class attractions just once, or perhaps more substantial discounts for low-income families, because, right now, as far as I can gather from the site, the more substantive discounts are just for seniors.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: However, if the Member would remember during the height of the COVID-19 crisis, where many of our attractions and, indeed, our tourism sector was hardest hit by COVID-19, we launched SingapoRediscovers Vouchers (SRVs).

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: And that, indeed, helped a lot of the attractions.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: It did not just help our tourism sector, but it also enabled Singaporeans to go out there and to participate and enjoy the many attractions we have to offer.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: So, please do visit and support our tourism attractions.
